result.question: Quais municípios com mais de 500 internações aparecem simultaneamente no top-20 de volume e no top-20 de taxa de mortalidade nos estados MA e RS?
result.gold_sql: WITH top_volume AS (SELECT mu.nome FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado IN ('MA', 'RS') GROUP BY mu.nome HAVING COUNT(*) > 500 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 20), top_mortalidade AS (SELECT mu.nome FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado IN ('MA', 'RS') GROUP BY mu.nome HAVING COUNT(*) > 500 ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 20) SELECT tv.nome FROM top_volume tv WHERE tv.nome IN (SELECT nome FROM top_mortalidade) ORDER BY tv.nome;
result.generated_sql: WITH municipio_internacoes AS (SELECT mu."nome" AS municipio, mu."estado", COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mortes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."codigo_6d" WHERE mu."estado" IN ('MA', 'RS') GROUP BY mu."nome", mu."estado" HAVING COUNT(*) > 500), ranked_municipios AS (SELECT municipio, estado, total_internacoes, taxa_mortalidade, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY estado ORDER BY total_internacoes DESC) AS rn_volume, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY estado ORDER BY taxa_mortalidade DESC) AS rn_taxa FROM municipio_internacoes) SELECT estado, municipio FROM ranked_municipios WHERE rn_volume <= 20 AND rn_taxa <= 20 ORDER BY estado, municipio;
